author: Turkey Tom
description:
NovaOnline began his online career with the most innocent of intentions - playing fortnite, brawlhalla, and other games for a humble audience. He likely would have gone completely unnoticed if not for his move from YouTube to TikTok - where he went viral for his appearance while reviewing various fast good items. Unfortunately for him, this virality would be a double - edged sword. Within months he was brutally exposed - today, he exists as one of the most infamous TikTok creators of all time. In part one, I covered his rise to prominence and how his allegations began. In part two, I documented his continued fall from what little grace he had, and his developing addiction to attention. Today, in part three, I'll go over everything that's happened since then - including some pretty unfortunate findings.
